description: A woman seen from behind in a long ivory satin gown with an off-shoulder lace bodice and a long lace-edged train, wearing a veil and a flower wreath. She stands in a dark Gothic-style chapel with wood paneling and lit candles on the altar, while a priest in white vestments waits. Men in military dress uniforms and women in gowns line the aisle, and onlookers watch from a gallery above. It reads as a 19th-century oil painting, with no visible text and no frame.
